visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and glasses is positioned in the center, wearing a black collared shirt. He is speaking directly to the camera against a backdrop of the Taipei skyline at night, with the Taipei 101 building clearly illuminated on the right. An inset video window shows a square piece of white cultured meat sizzling in a black frying pan. (2) The man uses active hand gestures, pointing at the inset image and then towards the camera. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setting. The city lights in the background are out of focus, creating a professional depth-of-field effect while he explains the concept of lab-grown meat. (3) Technical footage displays a top-down view of a fiber array, showing a grid of hundreds of white pins with thin fibers threaded between them. The camera pans slightly over the apparatus. The background is a dark laboratory setting, and the objects are presented with high clarity and neutral lighting. (4) The man returns to the frame, using his thumb and index finger to demonstrate a two-centimeter thickness. His facial expressions are animated and engaging. A secondary technical animation follows, showing a transparent rectangular box containing pink fibrous material and labeled with Chinese and English text for collagen and culture medium. (5) In the final phase, the man continues his monologue, eventually pointing downwards with both hands to direct viewers to the description or comments section. The scene maintains its high-contrast cinematic lighting and vibrant night-city colors.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 實驗室又做出人造肉了. [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Slogan]: 免殺雞! 科學家「養」出雞肉塊. (2) [Subtitle]: 欸先說清楚, 這不是用豆子做的素肉. (3) [Subtitle]: 這是用雞的細胞, 在實驗室裡長出來的雞肉塊. (4) [Subtitle]: 欸但之前不就已經做出來了嗎? (5) [Subtitle]: 欸注意, 這次不一樣, 這是一整塊厚厚的雞肉啊. (6) [Subtitle]: 為什麼這很難呢? 因為以前的培養肉沒有血管系統. (7) [Subtitle]: 細胞一旦長太厚就會缺氧. (8) [Subtitle]: 因此最多只能做成絞肉. (9) [Subtitle]: 東京大學的團隊做了一個重要突破. (10) [Subtitle]: 他們用一種中空纖維生物反應器. [Variety]: Topdown view of the fiber array after threading. (11) [Subtitle]: 模仿血管的功能, 把氧氣跟營養送進細胞堆裡. (12) [Subtitle]: 讓肌肉細胞成功長成厚達兩公分. [Variety]: 2 cm. (13) [Subtitle]: 重約 11 克的雞肉塊. [Variety]: 重約 11 克. (14) [Subtitle]: 而且還有雞胸肉那種厚實的口感. (15) [Subtitle]: 不過我比較喜歡雞腿. (16) [Subtitle]: 這種培養方式不用屠宰, 不用大量土地跟飼料. [Variety]: I型膠原蛋白&細胞 Type-I collagen & cells. [Variety]: 溫培養基 Warm culture medium. (17) [Subtitle]: 也不會造成環境污染. (18) [Subtitle]: 對糧食安全或氣候變遷來說, 或許是一種永續的做法. (19) [Subtitle]: 除了未來可望商業化. (20) [Subtitle]: 這項技術或許還能應用在醫療再生組織啊, 生物機器人. (21) [Subtitle]: 甚至太空上的食物. (22) [Subtitle]: 欸等等, 如果可以培育出雞的肉. (23) [Subtitle]: 那應該也能培育出我自己的肉. (24) [Subtitle]: 看樣子回家吃自己的那一天不遠了. (25) [Subtitle]: 想了解更多科學新聞嗎? 快點這裡. [Logo]: 泛科學. [Slogan]: 快留言許願 下週《泛科NEWS》就來報!.
